title: Perverts is out now
text: Perverts, a record of long drones and slowcore, was released on Daughters of Cain Records. It runs for roughly ninety minutes and sits outside the main Ethel Cain story.

title: New album and world tour announced
text: Ethel Cain announced Willoughby Tucker, I'll Always Love You, a lyrical prequel to Preacher's Daughter, together with a long world tour.

title: The Willoughby Tucker tour begins in Seattle
text: The world tour kicked off in Seattle with live debuts of songs from the new album, before moving on to the UK and Europe in the autumn.

title: Tour extended with 2026 dates
text: More shows were added to the tour, including a new North American leg in 2026.
